services.name: Electricity contract actions
services.summary: Victor's dialogue lists a 1,000 C electricity-and-gas commissioning fee, end-of-day consumption billing and city purchase of surplus energy; the matching action deducts 1,000 C and supports later termination.
services.zhSummary: Victor 的对话列出 1,000 C 电力与燃气合同启用费、按日末用量结算及城市收购富余能源；相符动作会扣除 1,000 C，并支持之后解约。

services.name: Water contract actions
services.summary: Victor's dialogue lists a 500 C water commissioning fee, end-of-day consumption billing and city purchase of excess clean water; the matching action deducts 500 C and supports later termination.
services.zhSummary: Victor 的对话列出 500 C 供水合同启用费、按日末用量结算及城市收购富余净水；相符动作会扣除 500 C，并支持之后解约。

services.name: Seed vendor catalogue and selling
services.summary: The seed-vendor dialogue exposes separate actions for opening the goods catalogue and selling items from the player's inventory.
services.zhSummary: 种子商人对话分别提供打开商品目录和从玩家背包出售物品的操作。

services.name: Bicycle rental terminal
services.summary: The bilingual terminal dialogue lists a 1 C day rental and a 100 C destruction penalty. It checks stock, deducts 1 C, marks the assigned bicycle with a green light and says staff collect it at day's end.
services.zhSummary: 双语终端对话列出 1 C 当日租金与 100 C 损毁罚款；它会检查库存、扣除 1 C、以绿灯标出分配的自行车，并说明工作人员在日末回收。

services.name: Taxi rental terminal
services.summary: The bilingual TaxiCo dialogue lists a 10 C day rental and a 100 C destruction penalty. It checks stock, deducts 10 C, marks the assigned taxi with a green light and reports when no taxi is available.
services.zhSummary: 双语 TaxiCo 对话列出 10 C 当日租金与 100 C 损毁罚款；它会检查库存、扣除 10 C、以绿灯标出分配的出租车，并在无车时给出提示。

services.name: Vehicle repair dialogue
services.summary: The country-mechanic path checks merchant availability, repairable vehicle content and sufficient funds before invoking a repair-all action; the displayed total is runtime-filled and no fixed amount is retained.
services.zhSummary: 乡村维修商路径会检查商人可用性、可维修车辆内容和资金是否足够，再执行全部维修；显示的总价由运行时填充，保留节点没有固定金额。

services.name: Animal infection treatment
services.summary: Susan's path describes an animal infection needing antibiotics and rest, checks a runtime-filled total and sufficient funds, then invokes the shared repair-all action. No fixed treatment price is retained.
services.zhSummary: Susan 的路径描述动物感染后需要抗生素和休息，会检查运行时填入的总价及资金是否足够，再调用共用的全部修复动作；保留节点没有固定治疗价格。

services.name: Subway travel actions
services.summary: The subway dialogue exposes local travel, international travel and a return-to-ranch action. A matching local-ticket node checks and deducts 3 C; a separate current-build line describes the metro as open 24/7, but runtime operation and the destination list remain untested.
services.zhSummary: 地铁对话提供本地出行、国际出行和返回牧场操作；相符的本地车票节点会检查并扣除 3 C。另一条当前构建对话称地铁全天 24 小时运营，但运行状态和目的地清单仍未实测。

services.name: Remote portal travel action
services.summary: Remote-portal dialogue describes entry to a shared space for meeting other Ranchers, includes respect/privacy/reporting guidance, and exposes options to return to the player's ranch or visit a friend. No fee, destination list or current availability is established.
services.zhSummary: 远程传送门对话把目的地描述为可与其他牧场主互动的共享空间，并提示尊重他人、保护隐私和反馈问题；离开时可返回自己的牧场或拜访朋友。费用、目的地清单和当前可用性仍未确定。

services.name: Clothing and accessories catalogues
services.summary: The clothing-shop dialogue opens separate clothing and accessories catalogues and also exposes an inventory selling action.
services.zhSummary: 服装店对话会分别打开服装目录与配饰目录，并提供从背包出售物品的操作。

services.name: Additional land purchase
services.summary: Victor's bilingual dialogue lists each additional plot at 300,000 C and directs the player to interact with the For Sale sign on the desired plot rather than return to City Hall.
services.zhSummary: Victor 的双语对话列出每块额外土地 300,000 C，并提示直接到目标地块与“待售”标识互动，无需再回市政厅。

services.name: Malcolm shop catalogue
services.summary: A Malcolm-named conversation exposes a View shop items action after a merchant-availability check; the retained dialogue does not identify inventory or hours.
services.zhSummary: 一组以 Malcolm 命名的对话在商人可用性检查后提供“查看商店商品”操作；保留对话不含库存或营业时间。

services.name: Meriam blueprint catalogue and selling
services.summary: Meriam-named conversations expose a blueprint catalogue and an inventory-selling action; the dialogue alone does not establish the catalogue contents, prices or hours.
services.zhSummary: 以 Meriam 命名的对话提供蓝图目录和从背包出售物品的操作；仅凭对话不能确定目录内容、价格或营业时间。

services.name: Country mechanic catalogue
services.summary: Country-mechanic conversations expose a catalogue action behind a merchant-availability check. The retained nodes do not list its contents or prove current stock.
services.zhSummary: 乡村维修商对话在商人可用性检查后提供商品目录操作；保留节点不列出目录内容，也不能证明当前库存。

services.name: Angela shop catalogue
services.summary: An Angela-named conversation exposes a View shop items action; the retained node does not list inventory, prices or hours.
services.zhSummary: 一组以 Angela 命名的对话提供“查看商店商品”操作；保留节点不含库存、价格或营业时间。
